blockers.whatFailed: 5 of 25 monitored patients have CGM device records that cannot be linked to their patient identity — the device stream carries a device ID that matches no patient on file. Check: device_patient_linkage_cgm
blockers.whatUnlocks: Once the vendor implements the device-to-patient ID crosswalk, these patients’ device streams become attributable and the weekly stratification review can include them on current device data.

blockers.whatFailed: 8 of 25 monitored patients still have CGM coverage below the configured 70% floor. Detection, flagging, and routing are complete; the underlying readings are unchanged — missing readings cannot be created by the platform. Check: device_temporal_density_cgm_14d
blockers.whatUnlocks: The platform’s half is done: the gap is characterized and routed. Restoring coverage is clinic-side work — device adherence outreach with these patients — after which the weekly stratification review can rely on their device data again.

blockers.whatFailed: 3 of 36 diabetes patients have no A1C result inside the configured 6-month recency window — a value exists on record, but it is too old to reflect current control. Check: fitness_recency_a1c
blockers.whatUnlocks: A current A1C — lab collection at the next visit, or device enrollment so continuous glucose data carries current glycemic monitoring — restores an up-to-date picture of control for these patients’ weekly review.

blockers.whatFailed: 2 patients still have an A1C-to-encounter date mismatch pending source-system confirmation (for example 1 of 5 A1C results discordant — OBS000174 resulted 2024-06-05 vs ENC000246 dated "20240506") — the two encounter dates that could not be auto-normalized. The format-only mismatches have been resolved. Check: layer5_date_concordance_a1c
blockers.whatUnlocks: Once the source system confirms the two remaining encounter dates, the A1C history’s date trail is fully reliable for review and reporting.

blockers.whatFailed: 6 of 35 hypertension patients have no smoking-status observation on record — a required variable for hypertension risk stratification was never captured at the point of care. Check: layer1_notnull_fields_smoking
blockers.whatUnlocks: Once smoking status is documented at the point of care, hypertension risk stratification can order the full panel for the weekly review instead of leaving these patients unscored.

blockers.whatFailed: 3 patients still have an encounter date that needs source-system confirmation (for example 3 of 36 linked facts discordant — ENC000246 dated "20240506" vs 3 linked facts at 2024-06-05): one ambiguous transposition and two impossible-month values. The four unambiguous format errors have already been normalized. Check: layer5_date_concordance
blockers.whatUnlocks: Once the source system confirms the three remaining dates, the encounter record is fully trustworthy for clinical quality and value-based care reporting.

criteria.label: CGM temporal density ≥ 0.70 over the 14-day window
Time-in-Range recomputation tolerance ± 2pp against raw readings
A1C recency: 6-month lookback from the evaluation date
Site-level display band: PARTIALLY_READY ≥ 0.85 of population READY

pipeline.label: Ingest
pipeline.description: Raw EHR and device extracts land in the staging tier exactly as delivered — nothing is altered on arrival.

pipeline.label: Parse
pipeline.description: Records are read against the expected structure; malformed records are identified at the earliest possible point and traced to their source feed.

pipeline.label: Normalize
pipeline.description: Values are standardized into the shared model; unambiguous corrections can be AI-assisted, with a human approving every change.

pipeline.label: Score
pipeline.description: The deterministic core: every check, variable, and pathway is evaluated against the configured criteria — same inputs, same results, every time.

pipeline.label: Readiness report
pipeline.description: Results are organized per use case: what is ready, what is blocked, and exactly why.

pipeline.label: Remediate
pipeline.description: Each blocker is routed to the role that can fix it; where an AI-suggested fix applies, it waits for human approval.

pipeline.label: Re-score
pipeline.description: Remediated data goes back through the same deterministic scoring path, and the readiness report is refreshed from the stored results.

pipeline.label: Unlock
pipeline.description: Use cases whose criteria are met come online — the weekly stratification review and downstream reporting run on data that is fit for purpose.
